source.text_it: Tutti i veicoli dotati di ruote gemellate hanno l’obbligo di essere dotati dei dispositivi antinebulizzazione dell’acqua presente sulla carreggiata in caso di pioggia

rows.text: El cuestionario marca FALSO. Colocar cámaras no basta: el vehículo necesita un sistema de cámaras y pantallas con los campos de visión y la homologación correspondientes. Algunas configuraciones de camión sustituyen los espejos principales, gran angular, de proximidad lateral y delantero por vistas de cámaras, por lo que la sustitución no está prohibida universalmente. Verifica la homologación del vehículo.
evidence: Official superiori question 30728 printed FALSO: the statement says cameras suitably placed may entirely replace mirrors, without specifying vehicle, mirror classes, system or approval. Official intended historic scope is not established.

MAN OptiView manufacturer description https://www.man.eu/global/en/truck/assistance-systems/digital-mirror-replacement-system/man-optiview.html — complete truck configuration replaces rear-view, wide-angle, kerb and front mirror functions using cameras and displays; another configuration retains the front mirror. This does not establish permission for all vehicles, mirror classes or arbitrary retrofits.

Daimler Truck https://www.daimlertruck.com/en/newsroom/pressrelease/trucks-from-mercedes-benz-safe-as-never-before-44842137 — production camera-monitor system replaces main and wide-angle mirrors in particular Actros/Arocs configurations with R46 certification.

review.review_evidence: Independently inspected cited MAN OptiView and Daimler sources and compared all four 30728 localizations; full OptiView configuration is the limited example, and system approval is required. EU 2021/535 consolidated Annex VIII Part 2 §§4.1–4.2 independently inspected. The EUR-Lex Regulation 165/2014 direct URL returned a JavaScript challenge; articles 32 and 34 of the original text were previously inspected via official PDF in earlier tachograph batch.

issues.reason: Il quesito afferma che gli specchi possono essere integralmente sostituiti da telecamere opportunamente disposte e stampa FALSO; le fonti attuali riconoscono sistemi telecamera-monitor in sostituzione di specchi. La formulazione non specifica categoria, omologazione o classe degli specchi; non è verificato che la sostituzione integrale sia esclusa in ogni caso né quale ambito sia inteso. Serve adjudicazione indipendente del conflitto.
